Headquarters: US, Remote

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

JFrog is seeking a dynamic and visionary leader to join as the Regional Vice President of Strategic Solution Engineering. In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of expanding JFrog’s presence within key accounts, driving the adoption of our cutting-edge DevOps,  DevSecOps, and MLOps solutions, and ensuring the success of our most strategic customers.

As Regional Vice President (RVP), you’ll lead a high-performing team of technical professionals, working with JFrog’s most strategic customers, forming strong customer relationships, delivering exceptional technical proofs of concept (POCs) and pre-sales guidance while acting as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders. Reporting directly to the VP, Strategics and Field CTO, you’ll align regional strategies with corporate objectives, ensuring revenue growth, customer happiness, strategy alignment, and market leadership.

As a RVP of Strategic Solution Engineering in JFrog you will... 

• Develop and execute strategies to drive customer happiness and revenue growth within strategic accounts.

• Align team efforts with market trends, corporate goals, and competitive insights to enhance regional impact.

• Lead and inspire a high-performing team of technical professionals, ensuring exceptional customer outcomes.

• Partner with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to align strategies and optimize processes.

• Engage with executive stakeholders, positioning JFrog as a strategic partner while addressing complex challenges.

• Stay ahead of DevOps, DevSecOps and MLOps trends, refining strategies to address customer needs effectively.

To be an RVP of Strategic Solutions in JFrog you need...

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software/SaaS, including 5+ years managing technical or solution-oriented teams.

• Proven ability to drive seven- and eight-figure deals using methodologies like MEDDPICC and value-based selling.

• Deep expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, and pre-sales activities such as needs analysis and product demonstrations.

• Proven track record of driving high-value deals, developing strategic account plans, and achieving corporate objectives.

• Exceptional analytical and communication skills, data driven, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel to engage with customers and support team success.

• Passionately drives agility and proactive approach, ensuring seamless alignment with stakeholders, customer goals, and JFrog's mission.

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package. This position has a base salary range between $192,000 to $215,000. Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jfrog-regional-vice-president-strategic-solution-engineering-central

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.
This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.
On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.
This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.
You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.
In this role you will
• 
Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.
• 
Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.
• 
Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.
• 
Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.
• 
Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.
• 
Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.
• 
Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.
• 
Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.
• 
Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.
• 
Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.
• 
Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.
Requirements
• 
10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.
• 
Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.
• 
Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.
• 
Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.
• 
Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.
• 
Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams …

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to support ElevenLabs' offline media and strategic marketing bets: from OOH billboards to niche sponsorships and experimental brand campaigns. You'll build the frameworks that tell us whether a channel with no click to track is actually working, partnering closely with Marketing and the Growth Data team.

• 
Design and run measurement for offline / out-of-home campaigns: geo holdout tests, matched-market tests, media mix modelling and incrementality studies.
• 
Partner directly with Marketing leadership on which niche channels, markets or formats to test next, and size the bet.
• 
Build models that combine offline spend data with digital and product signals into one coherent view of marketing effectiveness.
• 
Work alongside the Growth Data team's digital marketing data scientists to keep offline and online measurement consistent.

Requirements
Demonstrated experience measuring marketing effectiveness, ideally including offline, brand or hard-to-track channels (OOH, TV, podcast, sponsorship, events).
• 
Strong SQL and Python, with experience in causal inference, media mix modelling or incrementality testing.
• 
Comfort designing measurement without a clean click-level signal, and communicating uncertainty honestly.
• 
Strong stakeholder management with Marketing / Brand leadership, able to turn a strategic question into a testable plan.
• 
Structured thinker comfortable with ambiguity: this is a newer, less-defined function.

Bonus:
• 
Experience specifically with OOH, billboard or experiential campaign measurement.
• 
Experience with media mix modelling tools or frameworks (Robyn, Recast, LightweightMMM or similar).
• 
Experience partnering with brand or creative teams on niche or unconventional marketing bets.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
What you’ll do: 

• Lead a cross-platform team responsible for image rendering and video playback across Pinterest apps and web.

• Set the team’s technical direction and drive execution on quality, performance, and reliability for media experiences.

• Partner closely with Media Transcoding, Performance, Data Science, Product and Infrastructure teams to improve how media is delivered and experienced across Pinterest.

• Drive initiatives to reduce media load times, improve playback smoothness, and ensure high visual quality at scale.

• Guide the team through platform and architectural decisions, balancing product needs, technical investments, and long-term maintainability.

• Build and grow a high-performing team through hiring, coaching, and developing engineers.

• Raise the bar on engineering excellence through strong operational practices, performance measurement, testing, and release quality.

• Help Pinterest adopt new media technologies and formats in ways that improve the user experience for a global audience.

What we’re looking for:

• 9+ years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise in iOS or Android and solid familiarity with web technologies.

• 5+ years of engineering management experience leading strong client or platform engineering teams.

• Deep understanding of client performance, including profiling, instrumentation, and performance optimization.

• Strong technical foundation in media rendering, image delivery, video streaming, and client-side performance.

• Experience working with media frameworks such as AVFoundation and ExoPlayer.

• A track record of delivering meaningful improvements to product experience, system performance, or engineering efficiency.

• Ability to lead work across platforms and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.

• Clear communication skills, strong technical judgment, and a people-focused leadership approach.

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Relocation Statement: 

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to join our growing Bengaluru Product & Technology team to provide technical direction, direct architecture, and implement core parts of a new platform we are building to make it easier for customers to build AI applications using MongoDB. 

As an Engineering Manager on this new team, you will be responsible for leading and growing an engineering team, taking on challenging, high-visibility projects that improve and enhance the performance, scalability, and reliability of the distributed systems infrastructure for this new product. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Position Expectations

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Drive the architectural vision for the platform, ensuring it runs equally well on public clouds, private cloud environments and on-premise
  • Work with product managers, program managers, design & analytics teams and other teams to define, prioritize and deliver new features that delight our users and drive platform improvements
  • Take responsibility for the planning and execution of major features, raise delivery risks
  • Own the monitoring, operations, and maintenance of the systems your team develops
  • Enable the team to operate efficiently by removing technical obstacles, coordinating with other teams on dependencies, and prioritizing the team's overall well-being
  • Contribute to planning for organizational growth, including allocation of engineering resources, participate in hiring and assignment of projects

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience of building distributed systems, and/or foundational cloud services at scale and experience in languages like Python, Golang, Java or Rust 
  • 4+ years of experience managing a team of 6+ engineers and providing technical leadership
  • Track record in hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing software engineering teams, experience working with remote teams and a passion for mentoring and career development of the team
  • Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills and desire to collaborate with colleagues, other teams, and lead projects
  • Strong background in building core components for high-scale compute or data processing / distributed systems
  • Have led the launch of new features and maintained them in production
  • Bonus points for experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g. Kubernetes) and AI frameworks and tools
  • Be a force multiplier in our software development process. Enable teams to deliver great products through leadership and technical contributions
  • Eager to learn, with a strong technical background

Success Measures

  • In the first month, you’ll have understood the surface area, the high level architecture of the new platform. You’ll have initiated one-on-one’s with your team members
  • In three months, you’ll have on-boarded onto the team and contributed to the design and development of a core platform capability. Additionally started helping the team hiring and growth
  • In six months, you will have taken on full responsibility for projects slated for the subsequent quarter. You’ll have started growth conversations with your team members and begun to understand their longer-term career aspirations
  • In twelve months, you’ll have led the development of multiple new features and performed a full annual cycle of performance and growth conversations with your team members. Additionally, you’ll have contributed to the vision for the future of the platform and helped develop a plan to achieve that vision

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

About the Team
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as analytics, data engineering, business and product management, etc to solve complex problems for the organization.


What you will do
• 

Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the domain and technology landscape deeply through landscape analysis, user interviews/research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.

• 

Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.

• 

Vision: Ability to set forward looking vision and roadmap for the charter aligned with company’s goals

• 

Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

• 

Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (analytics, engineering, business, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, etc.

• 

Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.

• 

Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.

• 

Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

What you will need
• 

Overall experience of 7+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company with experience in data, analytics, engineering etc. 

• 

Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking

• 

Good understanding of technology and data landscape, and comfort with product management processes such as writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

Headquarters: Toronto, Ontario
 
URL: https://c4media.com/

C4Media, Inc. is looking for a Demand Generation Specialist (Contractor) to join our fully remote, global team.

You’ll own digital marketing campaigns that drive QCon registrations, certification enrollments, and InfoQ Live registrations. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where you’ll write copy, manage email campaigns and audience segments, run paid advertising, analyze performance, and continuously improve our marketing processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who enjoys building repeatable campaigns, reaching new audiences, and writing compelling content for a technical audience of senior software engineers and architects. Experience with marketing conferences, certifications, courses, or professional development is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

• Own end-to-end demand generation campaigns for QCon, certifications, and InfoQ Live.

• Create email sequences, landing page copy, social posts, and paid ad copy.

• Manage audience segmentation, exclusions, automations, and email campaigns.

• Plan and execute organic and paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, and social channels.

• Track and report weekly on registrations, enrollments, cost per registration, and revenue.

• Maintain marketing dashboards, trackers, and campaign calendars.

• Test new channels and strategies to reach audiences beyond our existing database.

• Build repeatable campaign processes and continuously improve performance.

• Coordinate campaigns across products while managing shared audiences and contact limits.

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, content creation, testing, analysis, and automation.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in digital marketing and demand generation, with a strong focus on email and lifecycle marketing.

• Proven experience driving measurable registrations, enrollments, leads, or sales.

• Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting skills for technical audiences.

• Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, and organic social media.

• Strong analytical and reporting skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

• A proactive approach to staying current with marketing platforms, tools, trends, and best practices.

• Comfortable using AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity.

Remote Work Requirements

• Must reside in Europe

• Able to work in a full-time remote position

• Able to work in overlap with our core global office hours (9 AM - 1 PM EST)

• Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-office setup

• Willing and able to travel to the USA or Europe 1–3 times per year for conferences and company meetings

Why work at C4Media

• Work from home - always: We are a remote-first and remote-always team that has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that.

• Travel the world: C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences & team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip.

• Take care of each other: We look out for one another and prioritize respect, fairness, support, and well-being. Check out our core values on our careers page.

• Learn something new: C4Media’s culture is one of learning & mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it.

• Make friends across the world: Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life.

• Support wellbeing: In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness.

• Generous paid time off: In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education.

Qualified candidates are to submit their applications on our C4Media website. Only candidates who submit their applications in English will be considered for this role (including resume).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/c4media-inc-demand-generation-specialist

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Software Engineer Intern for a duration of 6 months, starting on January 12th 2027. 

About the job

This position is needed to design, develop, deploy and operate software solutions and help Twilio deliver real-time, low latency capabilities for next-generation communications. Twilio Interns in Software Engineering are eager to learn and inspire and like to think at scale and meet high availability goals, bringing a focus to solving resiliency, latency and quality challenges in our virtualized cloud environment. Software Engineers want to develop technical skills and industry experience while working on complex distributed systems.

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer Intern you will experience the following -

  • Be a Software Engineer, not just an "intern".
  • Ship many different projects during the 6 months. 
  • Learn from passionate engineers at Twilio who solve problems in distributed computing, real-time DSP (audio processing), virtualization performance, distributed messaging, buses and more.
  • You will be given responsibility for core features and services that ship to our users.
  • You will be expected to embrace these challenges, learn fast and deliver great results.
  • You will bring a willingness to learn and grow and we will reciprocate with ample opportunity to do just that, in a friendly, fun and exciting startup environment! 
  • Learn to develop beautiful and profitable applications.
  • Demonstrate consistent improvement in your coding skills, issue-tracking and source control systems, and agile development mentality.
  • Participate in code reviews, bug tracking and project management with the rest of the Twilio Team. 

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required

  • To be working towards a Bachelors or Masters in computer science. 
  • To have a keen interest in software development with several side projects and perhaps are a part of the open source community.
  • To have a hungry entrepreneurial and "can do" spirit, as evidenced by successful interest in learning new technologies.
  • To have explored writing code in any of the following languages: Python/Java/Javascript/PHP/C or C++.

Desired

  • Having knowledge of unit and integration testing methodologies, and the ability to write, debug and deploy testing frameworks.
  • Experience in data processing, analytics, business intelligence, and reporting.
  • Experience with technologies such as Hadoop, spark, python, scala etc.

Location 

This role will be remote and based in India. Please note that you’d need to be located in one of the following five states for the duration of the internship: Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra & Delhi. 

What We Offer

There are many benefits to interning at Twilio, including competitive pay, generous time off, and flexible working! Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The BizTech BI&Analytics team partners with business and finance stakeholders to deliver scalable self-serve analytics & AI transformation programs, budgeting & forecasting solutions, reliable data pipelines, and trusted metrics & dashboards. Empowering timely, compliant, data-driven decisions and a robust analytics foundation across Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are seeking a skilled Senior Systems Engineer to support our Oracle EPM Planning systems and processes, with a strong focus on bringing AI automation and AI agent capabilities into Finance workflows. This is an important role within the Airbnb BizTech organization supporting Finance. The ideal candidate combines solid technical depth in the Finance Budgeting and Forecasting function with hands-on experience building AI automation and AI agents. Responsibilities include financial forecast modeling, system and AI-driven process transformation, integration with the data warehouse, and translating business requirements into scalable Oracle EPM and AI-enabled solutions.

A Typical Day:

Technical Support & System Admin

  • Application: Support the design, configuration, and maintenance of Oracle EPM Planning modules (Financials, Workforce, Capital, Cash Forecast, Long Range Planning, etc).
  • Calculations & Modeling: Develop and maintain business rules and calc scripts. Proficiency in Groovy Scripting for data and forecast modeling.
  • Data Integration: Support data flows with AWS data warehouse, Oracle ERP Cloud, and Workday, leveraging Data Management, EPM Automate, and internal Airbnb integration tools.
  • Environment Management: Assist with the monthly Oracle patch cycle, including regression testing and impact analysis of new features.

FP&A Functional Support

  • Process Improvement: Partner with FP&A to streamline the budget and forecasting process by automating manual offline models and enhancing data integration to reduce forecast cycle time and improve accuracy.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain reports using EPM Reports; support finance users in Smart View with ad-hoc analysis and template creation.
  • User Support: Support the monthly forecast cycle, resolving issues promptly and engaging Oracle support when needed.

AI Automation & Agent Development

  • AI Agent Building: Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows that streamline FP&A processes, using both native EPM AI capabilities and external AI/automation tooling.
  • Process Automation: Identify manual, repetitive finance and systems processes and apply AI automation to reduce cycle time and manual effort.
  • Collaboration: Work with Finance and Tech partners to prioritize AI automation opportunities and deliver AI-generated forecasts, analyses, and insights.

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Oracle Hyperion/EPM (minimum 2 years in EPM Cloud). Experience with EPM Automate, Groovy scripting, building forms, reports, application optimization, and administering user access.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting finance functions (FP&A, Accounting, Treasury, Tax) with solid financial statement literacy.
  • Hands-on experience building AI automation and AI agents (for example, agentic workflows, LLM-based automation using tooling such as Claude, Gemini, GPT - not specific to EPM's built-in AI).
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation, pipeline troubleshooting, and ad-hoc analysis against warehouse tables.
  • Experience supporting integrations between Oracle EPM and ERP via OIC or equivalent middleware.
  • Experience operating data orchestration and ETL/ELT pipelines: monitoring workflow health, managing and re-running failed tasks, reviewing execution logs, and coordinating pipeline incidents with owning teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work with cross-functional stakeholders and clearly document technical processes for non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions within or outside of EPM Planning, and to recommend options for decision making.

 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
  • Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
  • Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
  • Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
  • Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
  • Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
  • Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

What you will bring

  • Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
  • Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
  • Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
  • Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
  • Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
